prompt: Twelve repositories must run an identical, centrally versioned deploy job — one fix should reach all of them. Which construct fits?
explanation: A reusable workflow is called with `uses:` — including from another repository, pinned to a tag or SHA — so one central file serves many callers and one merge propagates everywhere. Anchors cannot cross files, and copies drift.

options.text: A composite action referenced by path in each repository
A reusable workflow, called with `uses:` and pinned to a ref
A YAML anchor shared through a symlink
Copying the deploy job into each repository’s workflow
